pages.title: Rootbinders
pages.text:
The Rootbinders grew living anchors: March flora whose roots ran along the Strands and held pads that would otherwise have drifted.

When the Loom was cut, the roots held for a season. That season is why anything is still up here.

pages.title: Sprout Strand
pages.text:
*Roots are the only rope the void respects.*

Seated. The Rootbinders answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text:
The Rootbinders keep a camp in the March steppe: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, a Water totem, a banner and four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver.

Their hearth favours saplings, seeds, Mossback Moss. Their Elder trades March saplings and Spirit Reed, and at Voice standing presses the tribe's Mark into your hand.
